title: Zesty Roasted Saudi Arabian Rice Risotto
description: A velvety, aromatic risotto with roasted carnaroli rice, fragrant spices, and a zesty citrus finish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and toss the carnaroli rice with 1 tbsp olive oil and the smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, and pinch of saffron, then spread on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes until lightly browned.
Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a donabe over medium heat and add the diced carrot, sautéing until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the roasted rice, coating it with the aromatics, and cook for 2 minutes to toast the grains.
Pour in 200 ml of the low-fodmap chicken stock and bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until the liquid is mostly absorbed, about 8 minutes.
Add the remaining 300 ml of stock a ladle at a time, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more, keeping the rice creamy, for a total of 15 minutes of simmering.
Stir in the lemon zest and dairy-free butter, allowing the butter to melt and enrich the risotto, then season with salt to taste.
Remove the donabe from heat, fold in the chopped parsley, and let the dish rest for 2 minutes to finish the velvety texture.
Serve hot, garnished with extra parsley if desired.
